A '''soldier''' in the [[People's Liberation Battalion]] on [[Eiattu 6]] was captured and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. After his interrogation, the [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]] was killed by the impostor [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Harrandatha Estillo (impostor)|Harrandatha Estillo]], leader of the People's Liberation Battalion, who was secretly working with Tavira.
